drg.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease without CC/MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 49-year-old male admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.71, creatinine 0.9, hemoglobin 14.7, pao2 57, platelets 246, sodium 139, wbc 7.3; vitals dbp 64-69, heart_rate 77-81, map 87-90, o2_flow 0-40, resp_rate 26-32, sbp 129-136, spo2 87-94, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; High-flow nasal cannula 40 L/min, FiO2 0.6; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.92, hemoglobin 14.7, platelets 249, sodium 140, wbc 7.2; vitals dbp 66-69, heart_rate 77-81, map 88-91, o2_flow 40, resp_rate 21-27, sbp 128-136, spo2 93-94, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 49-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
